rows.trigger: Create group
rows.testTitleMatch: group_created webhook fires with correct guid, name, type and owner

rows.trigger: Update group name
rows.testTitleMatch: group_updated webhook fires with the new name applied

rows.trigger: Delete group
rows.testTitleMatch: group_deleted webhook fires for the deleted guid

rows.trigger: Add member to group (REST, on behalf of owner)
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_added webhook fires with correct member and actor

rows.trigger: Remove group member
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_kicked webhook fires with correct member and actor

rows.trigger: Ban group member
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_banned webhook fires with correct member and actor

rows.trigger: Unban group member
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_unbanned webhook fires with correct member and actor

rows.trigger: Change a member's scope
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_scope_changed webhook fires with old and new scope

rows.trigger: Transfer group ownership
rows.testTitleMatch: group_owner_transferred webhook fires with correct old and new owner

rows.trigger: A real SDK client self-joins a public group (no REST equivalent — verified live)
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_joined webhook fires when a user joins a public group themselves

rows.trigger: A real SDK client self-leaves a group (no REST equivalent — verified live)
rows.testTitleMatch: group_member_left webhook fires when a user leaves a group themselves

rows.trigger: Send a text message
rows.testTitleMatch: message_sent webhook fires when a text message is sent

rows.trigger: Edit an existing message
rows.testTitleMatch: message_edited webhook fires when a message is edited, with the new text

rows.trigger: Delete a message
rows.testTitleMatch: message_deleted webhook fires when a message is deleted

rows.trigger: Add a reaction to a message
rows.testTitleMatch: message_reaction_added webhook fires with the correct emoji, message and reactor

rows.trigger: Remove a reaction from a message
rows.testTitleMatch: message_reaction_removed webhook fires with the correct emoji, message and reactor

rows.trigger: Send a message containing <@uid:...>
rows.testTitleMatch: user_mentioned webhook fires when a message mentions a user

rows.trigger: A real SDK client calls markAsDelivered (no REST equivalent — verified live)
rows.testTitleMatch: message_delivery_receipt webhook fires when a recipient client acknowledges delivery

rows.trigger: A real SDK client calls markAsRead (no REST equivalent — verified live)
rows.testTitleMatch: message_read_receipt webhook fires when a recipient client marks a message read

rows.trigger: Group message, sole other member marks it delivered — aggregate fires once every recipient has (verified live: does NOT fire for 1:1, only group)
rows.testTitleMatch: message_delivered_to_all webhook fires once every group member has received the message

rows.trigger: Group message, sole other member marks it read — aggregate fires once every recipient has (verified live: does NOT fire for 1:1, only group)
rows.testTitleMatch: message_read_by_all webhook fires once every group member has read the message

rows.trigger: Send message content that should be flagged by an active moderation rule
rows.reason: Live-probed 2026-09-04 against prod-eu: a message containing a 10+ digit phone-like pattern (the exact pattern this project previously observed CometChat block — see README "Moderation Engine" section) now sends cleanly as message_sent, not moderation_engine_blocked. The message's metadata does show a "human-moderation" extension ran (metadata.@injected.extensions.human-moderation.success = true), but no moderation_engine_blocked/approved webhook fired at all — most likely explanation, based on this project's prior experience with Group triggers (which had per-trigger checkboxes unchecked despite the category being "on"): the Moderation trigger category is present but not individually enabled in the webhook's trigger configuration. Needs Dashboard verification — see README "Known limitations".

rows.trigger: Send message content that clears active moderation checks
rows.reason: Same root cause as moderation_engine_blocked above — see that entry.

rows.reason: No REST or SDK equivalent exists for a human manually approving a flagged item — this is a Dashboard-only action.
